'''Barry Town United Football Club''' ({{langx|cy|Clwb Pêl-droed Tref Unedig y Barri}} or {{lang|cy|Clwb Pêl-droed Tref y Barri}}) is a [[semi-professional]] association football team based in [[Barry, Wales|Barry]], Wales. They currently play in the {{Welsh football updater|BarryTU}}.

They are known for representing Wales in Europe as winners of the Welsh top flight and [[Welsh Cup]] during the 1990s and early 2000s and have also competed in England's [[Southern Football League|Southern League]] and [[FA Cup]]. The team, which has contained more than 50 full internationals, is now run by supporters. They play at their traditional home of [[Jenner Park Stadium|Jenner Park]], Barry, which holds 3,500 spectators."}}
